verdict.rationale: A probe confirms DeepInfra runs a public status page (status.deepinfra.com) that returns HTTP 200 and displays operational status, which a founder could check before committing production traffic. However, the evidence does not show an incident-history log, uptime SLA, or past-incident detail on that page, so the story is only partially confirmed. Missing for 10: evidence of incident history/timeline, uptime percentage stats, or independent commentary on past outages.
